Plot correlation matrix

Source: R/plot_cor_matrix.R
plot_cor_matrix.Rd

Plot correlation matrix between samples as a heatmap

Usage

plot_cor_matrix(
  se_obj,
  assay = 1,
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
  method = c("spearman", "pearson", "kendall"),
  label_group = TRUE,
  label_time = TRUE,
  label_rep = TRUE,
  label_batch = TRUE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  fontsize = 8,
  cellwidth = 1,
  cellheight = 1,
  title = NULL,
  shared_only = FALSE,
  names = NULL,
  plot_cophenetic = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

se_obj

A SummarizedExperiment object created by create_input(), or a named list of SummarizedExperiment objects (one per dataset).

assay

The assay to use in the SummarizedExperiment object: a numeric index or character name, e.g. 1 or "orig" for original data, 2 or "norm" for time 0 normalised data. (Default: 1.)

use

Parameter of stats::cor() (default is "pairwise.complete.obs")

method

Parameter of stats::cor() (default is "spearman")

label_group

Whether to label Group (default is TRUE)

label_time

Whether to label Time (default is TRUE)

label_rep

Whether to label Replicate (default is TRUE)

label_batch

Whether to label Batch (default is TRUE)

show_rownames

Whether to show row names in the heatmap (default is FALSE)

show_colnames

Whether to show column names in the heatmap (default is FALSE)

fontsize

Font size for the plot (default is 8)

cellwidth

Cell width for the heatmap (default is 1)

cellheight

Cell height for the heatmap (default is 1)

title

Title of the heatmap. If NULL, auto-generated as "Sample correlation ()" with the method capitalised (e.g. "Sample correlation (Spearman)") (default: NULL)

shared_only

Logical, whether to subset each dataset to the features shared by all datasets before computing correlations (default is FALSE; only applies when se_obj is a list of multiple datasets)

names

Optional character vector of dataset names for the per-heatmap titles. Default: NULL, i.e. the names of se_obj (when a list). Only applies when se_obj is a list of multiple datasets.

plot_cophenetic

Logical, whether to include the pairwise Pearson correlations of cophenetic distances in the combined plot title (default is FALSE) in addition to reporting by text.

...

Additional arguments to be passed to ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap()

Value

A heatmap showing the correlation between samples. With a named list of datasets, all heatmaps share the same colour scale, including pairwise correlations of cophenetic distances in the combined title when plot_cophenetic is TRUE, and are returned invisibly as a named list of Heatmap objects.

Details

With a named list of datasets that share the same samples, the per-dataset dendrograms are compared pairwise using Pearson correlations of their cophenetic distances (see ?stats::cophenetic).

Examples

data(example_obj)
data(example_obj_2)
plot_cor_matrix(example_obj)

plot_cor_matrix(list(Exp1 = example_obj, Exp2 = example_obj_2))
#> Cophenetic correlation between datasets (Pearson): 0.83
